title: Should Homework Be Shorter?
text:
Many parents and teachers ask whether homework helps students learn. In a persuasive essay, the writer should choose one side and defend it clearly. For example, short homework can help students practise what they learned in class. It also teaches them to manage their time.

However, some people believe that long homework causes stress and leaves little time for sport and family. A good writer does not ignore this argument. Instead, the writer can suggest a compromise, such as limiting homework to twenty minutes a night. This answer shows that the writer has thought carefully about both sides.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what can short homework help students do?
options: Practise what they learned in class

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what do some people believe about long homework?
What can be inferred about the writer's attitude toward the topic?
options: The writer wants to persuade readers with balanced reasons
The writer is completely against all homework
The writer has no opinion on the topic
The writer only tells a personal story

questions.text: Why does the writer suggest a compromise?
options: To show that both sides were considered
To prove that teachers are wrong

vocabulary.definition: trying to convince the reader to agree with an opinion
to do an activity again and again in order to learn it
an agreement where each side accepts less than it wanted
a feeling of worry or pressure caused by difficult situations

paragraph_translations: Багато батьків і вчителів запитують, чи допомагає домашнє завдання учням вчитися. У переконливому есе автор має обрати одну сторону і чітко її захищати. Наприклад, короткі домашні завдання можуть допомогти учням закріпити те, чого вони навчилися на уроці. Вони також вчать керувати своїм часом.

Однак деякі люди вважають, що великі домашні завдання викликають стрес і залишають мало часу для спорту та сім'ї. Хороший автор не ігнорує цей аргумент. Натомість автор може запропонувати компроміс, наприклад обмежити домашнє завдання двадцятьма хвилинами на вечір. Ця відповідь показує, що автор уважно обміркував обидві сторони.
